DESCRIPTOR.STUDY_ABSTRACT: We resequenced genomic DNA from Physalia specimens collected around the world. Sequencing depth varies across samples. Specimens were largely collected from the beach, and DNA extracted from tentacle tips. The objective was to investigate population structure and diversity of Physalia.
